description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book Seabreezy:* Spacious Home in Highland Parks* Bicycles (4) Included for Easy Beach Access* Relaxing Screened Porch* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community Grilling Area, 360-Observation Tower* Close to Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center* Under 1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery* Blue Mountain Beach Access- 1.3 miles (Parking, Restrooms and Seasonal Lifeguards)* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * Welcome to Seabreezy at Highland Parks in Blue Mountain Beach, where relaxation meets adventure along scenic 30A. This beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home comfortably sleeps up to 11 guests, making it the perfect setting for family vacations or group getaways. Nestled in a quiet, family-friendly neighborhood, Seabreezy offers a peaceful retreat while keeping you close to the best of 30A, with four adult bicycles included for easy rides to the beach and nearby hotspots like Gulf Place, Seaside, WaterColor, and Seacrest. Inside, you’ll find hardwood floors, granite and quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and stylish coastal décor throughout. The fully equipped kitchen with a spacious center island is perfect for gathering after a day in the sun. The welcoming foyer opens to a back patio and beautifully lit courtyard, creating a warm and inviting space for evening conversations. Two covered porches, including one screened-in, offer ideal spots for morning coffee or sunset wine. The first floor features a queen guest bedroom and a convenient half bath. Upstairs, the master suite boasts a king bed and private bath, while a second guest room includes a queen bed and twin sleeper chair. The bunk room offers a twin-over-full bunk with a twin trundle, and these two bedrooms share a Jack-and-Jill bathroom. Come start making unforgettable memories at Seabreezy.Bed Setup:First Floor: Guest Bedroom 1: Queen BedSecond Floor: Master Bedroom: King Bed + Private BathroomGuest Bedroom 2: Queen Bed + Twin Sleeper ChairGuest Bedroom 3: Twin-over-Full Bunk with Twin TrundleHighland Parks is the newest neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and is surrounded by great eateries and local eclectic shops. Highland Parks is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites The Perfect Pig, Red Door, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.*We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates* Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!AREA ATTRACTIONS: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
